# glinet_network_isolation (Resource)

Manage the stock GL.iNet per-network isolation options (`secure_option` sections).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network` (String) Network name, such as `lan`, `guest`, or `iot`.

### Optional

- `ap_isolate` (Boolean) Prevent wireless clients from reaching each other.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `transfer_enable` (Boolean) Allow transfers between isolated networks.
- `wan_isolate` (Boolean) Prevent this network from reaching the WAN.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
